messages:
FinanceOps: Monthly reconciliation flagged invoice INV-GCP-2026-1182: reserved-instance credits appear on project `reservations-host` instead of consuming projects. Short by ~$18.2k. Need allocation plan and vendor escalation. :wave:
cloud-ops: Can confirm billing export shows credits only on `reservations-host`. Quick SQL I ran: `SELECT project_id, SUM(credit_amount) FROM billing_view.gcp_billing_export_v1_67890.* WHERE invoice_month='2026-03' GROUP BY project_id;` result: reservations-host $12k credits, consumers 0.
eng-ml: We consolidated reservations into `reservations-host` in Feb; expectation was auto-apply across projects. If vendor billed host only, we may need dispute.
sara: I'll open a vendor dispute but need a temporary internal allocation so teams don't show overspend. Propose prorating credits by GPU-hours. Can cloud-ops pull GPU-hours by project for March?
cloud-ops: ran query: vision-models 1200 GPU-hrs, gen-nlu 335, infra-test 45, other 20 (total 1600). I'll document output and attach to the case.
FinanceOps: Allocation calc done: vision-models $9000, gen-nlu $2500, infra-test $340, other $160 (provisional). I'll create ledger transfers labeled PROV-ALLOC-2026-03 and note vendor case INV-GCP-2026-1182.
billing-bot: Ticket BILL-998 opened: "Reserved credits applied to host project; provisional re-allocation created". Assignee: sara. SLA: 10 business days.
vendor-liaison: I'll draft vendor email and include infra commit history showing reservation host change (commit 8f3acb1). Vendor contact: acme-cloud-rep@vendor.example.
sara: thanks. If vendor refunds to host, we'll reverse provisional transfers. If they refuse, we keep as corporate reallocation and update budgets. Closing thread; follow BILL-998 for updates. :white_check_mark:
